## 3. By contract kind

The same set partitioned by materialization shape. Entity and codeset contracts are SCD2-merged; event and transaction contracts are append-only with `correction_indicator` semantics. The cross-cutting ADR is `references/design-decisions/pc/event-and-transaction.md`.
